serverInfo.name: symloop-ai
serverInfo.title: Symloop AI — Deep-Tech AI Discovery
serverInfo.description: Read-only MCP server exposing Symloop AI's capabilities and engagement model. Symloop AI is a deep-tech AI engineering company in Algiers, Algeria — builders of NOOR (sovereign AI platform) and production AI systems for banks, ministries, oil & gas operators, and hospitals across MENA. The AI engineering arm of Symloop Technology (founded 2012, 25+ senior engineers).

list.name: get_noor_overview
list.description: Returns the NOOR sovereign AI platform overview — positioning, the 12 capabilities, deployment options (on-premise, sovereign cloud, hybrid, air-gapped), target sectors. Use when a buyer asks about Symloop's AI platform.

list.name: get_noor_capabilities
list.description: Returns detailed descriptions of NOOR's 12 standard capabilities: plain-language interface, document AI, RAG, multi-agent systems, NL-to-SQL, compliance reports, knowledge libraries, specialized assistants, on-premise/sovereign deployment, audit trail, Arabic NLP, production SLA.

list.name: get_sector_use_cases
list.description: Returns NOOR's pre-built use cases per sector. Inputs: sector slug. Supported: banking, insurance, government, manufacturing, oil-gas, healthcare, retail, telecom.

list.name: get_compliance_frameworks
list.description: Returns the regulatory frameworks Symloop AI delivers compliance against: BCT, SAMA, DORA, ISO 27001, HDS, GDPR, IFRS-17.

list.name: get_engagement_model
list.description: Returns Symloop AI's engagement model: 2-week paid discovery sprint (~$12K USD) → 6–18 month production engagement ($60K to $1M+) → 99.9% SLA managed operations or full handover with 90-day stabilization warranty.

list.name: request_noor_demo
list.description: Schedules a 60-minute NOOR demo tailored to the buyer's sector and data. Inputs: sector, target deployment (on-prem/sovereign/hybrid/air-gapped), regulatory framework, contact details.

list.name: request_quote
list.description: Submits a qualified engagement inquiry. Inputs: scope, timeline, budget range, sector, geography, contact details.

list.name: get_named_clients
list.description: Returns the list of named clients Symloop AI has shipped production work for: Epson (UAE), Del Monte (UAE), Renault Algérie, Offto, Barugzai.

list.name: NOOR — Sovereign AI Platform
list.description: Flagship product. Sovereign AI engineered for MENA's regulated industries. On-premise / sovereign cloud / hybrid / air-gapped deployment. Audited for BCT, SAMA, DORA, ISO 27001, HDS, IFRS-17.

list.name: About Symloop AI
list.description: Deep-tech AI engineering arm of Symloop Technology. Algiers HQ since 2012. 25+ senior engineers, no subcontracting. Source code, model weights, and runbooks belong to the client at engagement end.

list.name: Compliance Frameworks
list.description: Compliance documentation against BCT (Banque d'Algérie), SAMA (Saudi Central Bank), DORA (EU resilience), ISO 27001, HDS (French health data), GDPR, IFRS-17.
